# PWA Push Notification Developer Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Frontend > PWA

## Overview

Implements push notification functionality for PWAs with subscription management, notification display, and user engagement strategies

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [pwa-push-notification-developer-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
pwa-push-notification-developer-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@pwa-push-notification-developer` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Implement Push API with VAPID key authentication
- Manage push subscription lifecycle and storage
- Display rich notifications with actions and images
- Handle notification clicks with proper navigation

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Push API**: Web Push protocol and browser API
- **Notification API**: Notification display and interaction patterns
- **VAPID**: Voluntary Application Server Identification
